stack: TBD by replica-architect (HIPAA-defensible; encrypted at rest)

recon_from: the user's OWN trial account if one exists
never: copy code, logo, copy, images, fonts, or content
copy clinical content, note text, or client data

features.name: Client records and appointment calendar
features.acceptance: Create a client, book an appointment, see it on a day/week view; appointment links to the client chart.
features.verify: e2e: create client -> book -> assert appears in calendar and on client record

features.name: Appointment reminders
features.acceptance: Reminder schedule is configurable; reminder jobs are queued with correct send time and are idempotent (no duplicate sends).
features.verify: unit: reminder scheduler producing send times; assert no duplicates on re-run

features.name: Notes: templates, e-signature, timestamps
features.acceptance: SOAP, DAP and free-form templates save; signed note records author, UTC timestamp and a content hash; signed notes are immutable.
features.verify: integration: sign note -> attempt edit -> assert rejected; assert timestamp+hash present

features.name: Audit trail
features.acceptance: Every read and write of client data writes an audit row (actor, action, entity, timestamp); audit rows cannot be modified or deleted through the app.
features.verify: integration: perform N operations -> assert N audit rows; assert update/delete of audit rows is blocked

features.name: Secure client portal: intake, consent, messaging
features.acceptance: Client receives a tokenised link with no account required; completes intake and e-signs consent; practitioner sees completed artefacts attached to the client.
features.verify: e2e: send intake -> complete in clean context -> assert artefacts stored against client

features.name: Take payment via the practitioner's own Stripe + record cash/transfer
features.acceptance: Test-mode card payment flips the session to paid; manual cash/transfer entry records method and date; no platform fee added.
features.verify: integration: Stripe test payment + manual entry; assert ledger totals reconcile

features.name: Superbill generator
features.acceptance: Generates a per-client superbill PDF for a date range containing client name, practitioner name and NPI/tax id, dates of service, CPT/service codes, diagnosis code, charged amount and paid amount.
features.verify: render PDF -> assert ALL required fields present via text extraction; assert date-range filtering correct

features.name: Telehealth via third-party embed
features.acceptance: A session can launch an embedded third-party video room from the appointment; room link is per-appointment and not guessable.
features.verify: e2e: launch room -> assert unique per-appointment URL; assert dependency is an external SDK, not custom WebRTC

features.name: Data export and portability
features.acceptance: Full export of clients, appointments, notes and payments in an open format (CSV/JSON) plus PDF notes; export completes for a seeded 100-client dataset.
features.verify: integration: seed 100 clients -> export -> assert row counts + parseability

features.name: HIPAA-defensible baseline
features.acceptance: Encryption in transit and at rest; no PHI in logs; secrets only in env; BAA-required third parties are documented; production build fails if a secret is referenced client-side.
features.verify: test: assert logger redaction, assert no secret strings in client bundle, assert TLS-only config

features.name: Scope guard: no insurance billing
features.acceptance: No claims, clearinghouse, eligibility or ERA/EOB code paths exist. This absence is the product thesis and must be asserted.
features.verify: grep/unit: assert no claims/clearinghouse/ERA modules present
